summary: Tickler 0.1.0 has no filled controls. Only active navigation and calendar selections have a thin theme-coloured border; clickable text stays bright, static labels are muted, and a line separates days and months. npm run verify passes 16 tests and all 12 acceptance categories.
limitations: The updated build has not been retested in the real Obsidian app; Finder dragging, physical Linux, cloud sync, and direct mail-app dragging remain untested.
The browser harness uses the real view code with a thin host stub. Light/dark theme adaptation is demonstrated there, but individual community themes remain untested.
